notes.title: Video deep-dive into the corkboard's design!
notes.content:
In case you missed it, I was recently interviewed for an excellent video deep-dive into the design behind the conspiracy corkboard! It's absolutely worth a watch if you enjoyed the game. There's a bunch of development stories about how the corkboard changed over time (and how it's design influenced the entire game).

[previewyoutube=XhxElfzunbs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.03
notes.content:
This is a minor patch, resolving some rare but pesky bugs:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would register phantom controller inputs
[*] Repositioned some rogue push-pins
[*] Fixed a rare bug where exiting just before the end credits would soft-lock the game
[*] Fixed a UI bug where options in the settings menu wouldn't appear at certain resolutions
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.02
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Just another quick patch for some ongoing issues:

[list]
[*] Added an option to turn off the letterbox effect
[*] Fixed a bug in the settings menu which could lead to the resolution scaling down automatically
[*] Fixed a rare bug which could soft-lock the final sequence of the game
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.01
notes.content:
Hi everyone! This is just a quick patch fixing a couple of issues that people ran into:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where loading the game would sometimes make twine get stuck to the corkboard
[*] Prevented the game from picking up irrelevant joystick inputs
[*] Reduced mouse-stutter from Anti-Aliasing (and also added a tooltip about mouse stutter in the settings menu)
[*] Fixed an issue with quality settings on Linux builds
[/list]

notes.title: A Hand With Many Fingers wins at the 2020 Freeplay Awards!!!
notes.content:
At last night's awards ceremony for the Freeplay Independent Game Festival, [i]A Hand With Many Fingers[/i] won the [b]Excellence in Design[/b] category as well as the overall [b]Freeplay Award[/b]!

A huge thank you to everyone at Freeplay, and I strongly recommend you check out all the other nominated games - you won't be disappointed!

Full list of awards/nominees: https://www.freeplay.net.au/awards/

Full stream of the awards ceremony: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8KbQ4VnMACM

notes.title: A Hand With Many Fingers is now released!
notes.content:
A Hand With Many Fingers is now officially out! So excited to hear what everyone thinks of it :D

And for the first 48 hours, I'll be donating 50% of all sales to Sisters Inside. They do amazing work supporting criminalised women/girls in Australia, and helping to get them out of jail.

First Nations women and girls are hugely over-represented in Australia's racist prison system.

notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
Prepare your tinfoil hat and keep an eye out for surveillance!

[i]A Hand With Many Fingers[/i] will be releasing on the 9th/10th of June (depending on your timezone).

Wishlist the game and you'll get a notification the very second it launches :D
